prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Formalize Your Pet's Adoption", "Customize your pet's official companion certificate and preview them live.", "Companion Name"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Controls 101", "Learn the essential shortcuts to interact with, move, or hide your companion anytime on your desktop.", "Right-click pet for Quick Menu & Hide", "Double-click to start voice & text chat", "Drag and drop to place anywhere on screen"]
2: ["Sign In & Keep Your Pets Safe", "Connecting your account ensures your adoption progress, customized pets, and stats are saved across launches.", "Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account to restore it immediately."]
3: []
4: ["Use clear, well-lit photos with a single subject for the best pet generation outcome.", "Recommended: Clear lighting, frontal view"]
5: ["Preparing Your Desktop Pet", "1. Rendering pet companion assets\n2. Setting up desktop overlay system\n3. Spawning pet onto display"]
6: ["Select Your Journey", "Pick between creating a unique AI companion or adopting a classic pre-made pet."]
7: ["Choose Your New Best Friend", "Swipe or tap to inspect pet personalities and animations"]
8: ["Can't see your pet? Click the tray icon or press Ctrl+Shift+P to reveal your companion on top.", "Tip: Pet stays on top of open windows"]
9: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "A living, interactive virtual companion right on your computer screen."]
